levels.surface: أبو عامر عبد الملك بن عمرو

notes: two taḥwīl branches: the second («ح وحدثنا محمد بن عمرو ...») ends at «قرة» and carries «بإسناد يحيى بن سعيد», a back reference to Yahya's isnad, which runs through Ibn Sirin
«عن أبي بكرة» comes after the last «ح», so it is the shared tail for both branches (rule 3)

the unnamed «رجل» of the first branch is named by «وسمى الرجل حميد بن عبد الرحمن» (rule 8); the name sits in the first branch's last level. That phrase is an editor's gloss between dashes, kept because it names the man
the second group is a second isnad with the same saying, not a variant
